evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Standing monthly rehearsal of the rollback path is a stability and keep-what-works move; the text does not name security or safety outright.

The aphorism grounds assurance in having rehearsed the rollback, appealing to security. It is torn with competence, but the claim is about whether a safeguard exists, so conservation is the closer fit.
